name: sim_cvc5_linear_logic_resource_constraint
description: Linear logic resource constraints: Girard's linear logic enforces each formula used exactly once unless marked with ! (of-course modality). Tests UNSAT when resource invariants violated.

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/logical computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG not needed; proof structure encoded as constraint variables

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs

cvc5.reason: load-bearing SMT solver for linear logic resource constraint UNSAT proofs

sympy.reason: supportive verification of sequent calculus resource conservation

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; proof theory via cvc5/sympy

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; no differential geometry required

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; proof structure encoded directly in constraints

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; no hypergraph structure

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard logical computations sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology required

test_single_use_no_bang.description: A used once without ! should be satisfiable

test_bang_allows_multiple.description: !A used multiple times should be satisfiable

test_reuse_without_bang_unsat.description: Formula used twice without ! should be UNSAT (linear logic violation)

test_bang_inconsistent_branch_unsat.description: !A with 0 uses (weakening) and 2 uses (contraction) in same branch is UNSAT

test_zero_uses_with_bang.description: !A with zero uses (weakening) should be satisfiable

test_sympy_sequent_calculus.description: Sympy verification: Γ={A,B}, Δ={C} => Γ,Δ ⊢ A⊗B uses 3 formulas
